# Project memory snapshot (point-in-time)

Copied 2026-08-30 from `C:\Users\curt\.claude\projects\D--src-dbsp-net\memory\` on the Windows i9
box, so that Claude Code project memory survives the move to a new machine. See
`docs/handoff-machine-migration.md` §4.1.

**To restore:** copy the `*.md` files (including `MEMORY.md`, the index) into the new machine's
project memory directory — `~/.claude/projects/<mangled-project-path>/memory/`.

**After restoring, this copy is stale.** Do not edit it and do not treat it as a second source of
truth. The authoritative record of decisions is `docs/`; live memory is whatever the new machine
holds.
